name: Citizenship by Marriage to a BiH Citizen

requirements.blocker_text: The Law on Citizenship of Bosnia and Herzegovina requires at least 5 years of marriage to a BiH citizen combined with holding permanent residence in Bosnia and Herzegovina -- there is no separate standalone residence-duration requirement layered on top, unlike the standard naturalization track. Applicants must also renounce their prior nationality unless a bilateral treaty exempts them (see ba_citizenship_naturalisation.json for BiH's limited treaty coverage on this point).
requirements.fix_path: Marry a BiH citizen, obtain permanent residence, remain married for at least 5 years, and renounce prior nationality unless treaty-exempt.

evidence_required.document: Proof of renunciation of prior nationality (unless treaty-exempt)

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: permanent residence held throughout the 5-year marriage

sources.title: Advokat Prnjavorac (Bosnian law firm/legal-text portal) -- Law on Citizenship of BiH, marriage-based acquisition, 5-year/permanent-residence requirement, renunciation and treaty exceptions

MARQUEE STRUCTURAL DISCLOSURE (shared across this country's settled-category files): Bosnia and Herzegovina runs a dual-level citizenship system -- state-level BiH citizenship (governed by the Zakon o drzavljanstvu BiH referenced here) coexists with separate entity-level citizenship in either the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina or Republika Srpska, each with its own administrative procedures; every BiH citizen also holds one entity citizenship, but this file models only the state-level acquisition route, since entity-level procedural variation was not independently researched in this build.
